name: opencode-gemini-app-auth
description: Zero-dependency native HTTP/2 Google Gemini App provider plugin for Magpie and OpenCode (official quota windows, multi-account pooling, caller-validated tools, structured outputs, and image inputs).

summary.en: Direct native HTTP/2 Google Gemini App provider with official quota windows and multi-account support.
summary.zh: 原生 HTTP/2 直连 Google Gemini App，支持官方 5h/每周配额与多账号调度。
